name: dasel
description: Universal data selector with jq-like syntax for JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV - 3x faster than jq, zero dependencies, format conversion

dasel.description: Universal data selector supporting JSON, YAML, TOML, XML, CSV with unified query syntax and format conversion - up to 3x faster than jq with zero runtime dependencies
dasel.usage:
dasel -f config.yaml '.database.host' # Query any format
dasel -f data.json '.users.[0].name' # Extract nested values
dasel -f input.csv -w yaml # Convert CSV to YAML
dasel -f config.toml '.servers' -w json # Convert TOML to JSON
dasel -f data.json put '.timestamp' -v '2023-01-01' # Modify data in place
